sources.snippet: In this release we are opening the weights of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a multimodal MoE model that also serves as an early preview of the architecture used in Qwen4. It plays the same role that Qwen3-Next played for Qwen3.5: the hybrid Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention design introduced at that time has since been used across the Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, Qwen3.7 and Qwen3.8 series. sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Experimental) 1 Introduction ¶ Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model and an experimental preview of the architecture that will underpin Qwen4. Its language model combines Gated DeltaNet and Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA), gated residual connections, Position Learning Enhancement (PLE), and a native Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) head.
